nodes.summary: Finite-dimensional spaces have the approximation property: the identity operator is itself finite-rank.
nodes.title: Finite-dimensional spaces have the approximation property

nodes.summary: A Hilbert space with a Hilbert basis indexed by `ℕ` has the approximation property, via the associated Schauder basis (`HilbertBasis.toSchauderBasis`).
nodes.title: Separable Hilbert spaces have the approximation property

nodes.summary: A Banach space with a Schauder basis has the approximation property. The partial-sum projections are finite-rank, converge pointwise to the identity, and are uniformly bounded by the Banach–Steinhaus theorem (`SchauderBasis.exists_norm_proj_le`); pointwise convergence plus uniform boundedness gives uniform convergence on compact sets via a finite `ε`-net argument.
nodes.title: Banach spaces with a Schauder basis have the approximation property

nodes.summary: A normed space has the approximation property if, on every compact set, the identity operator is a uniform limit of finite-rank continuous linear operators.
nodes.title: Approximation property

nodes.title: Negative answer to Mazur's Problem 153

nodes.summary: The approximation property passes to complemented subspaces: if `P` is a continuous projection onto the submodule `F`, restrict a finite-rank approximant on the ambient space via `P`. The key point is that `P` fixes every point of `F`, so `P (S x) - x = P (S x - x)` for `x ∈ F`.
nodes.title: Approximation property passes to complemented subspaces

nodes.summary: The approximation property is preserved under continuous linear equivalence: conjugate a finite-rank approximant by the equivalence.
nodes.title: Approximation property is invariant under linear isomorphism

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
